a few well-placed heterogeneous nodes can have a significant impact on the performance of a sensor network.

a modest number of heterogeneous resources can have a dramatic positive impact on performance in ad hoc sensor and actuator networks, and that the impact of heterogeneity on performance increases with network size.

(1) heterogeneity can significantly increase the performance of sensor networks, but the gains are not linearly proportional to the number of heterogeneous nodes; (2) the gains from heterogeneity increase with the size of the network; and (3) the optimal placement of heterogeneous nodes is very hard in practice, and a simple heuristic can achieve a significant part of the gains.
